verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not mention CDN-worker SDKs, edge runtime integrations, or a relay/proxy layer for evaluating flags close to users. Local evaluation by server SDKs and on-device client SDKs is a related capability, but it is not documented edge or relay evaluation.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users
